description: This is an Android Activity class named CartActivity that manages the shopping cart UI. It handles UI setup, user interactions such as updating item quantities, removing items, clearing the cart, and navigation. It observes ViewModel LiveData and flows to update the UI with cart data, summaries, and error events.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the cart UI, user interactions, and state binding for the shopping cart screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds data to the views.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the activity toolbar with title and back navigation.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView with an adapter for cart items and defines action handlers for increment, decrement, and remove actions.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets click listeners on 'Clear Cart' and 'Checkout' buttons, handling confirmation dialogs and placeholder actions.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Collects flows from the ViewModel to update UI components with cart items, summary, and item counts.

methods.name: bindErrorsAndIdentity
methods.description: Handles missing email prompt and displays network error snackbars with retry actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu item selections, specifically the back navigation.
